_purpose: GOAL-COHORT: clean-court minimum starters staged under the 2026-08-21 doctrine pair (§CLEAN-COURT-MINIMUM-STARTER + §CONSENSUS-KILL). The doctrine flipped WAIT->starter as the default; this cohort GRADES that flip. Count-goals-bend-selection discipline: the ruling created these positions, so the ruling gets measured — cohort P&L + stop-rate vs (a) the pre-doctrine WAIT counterfactual and (b) SPY over the same window. Also instruments the red-overturn lenience question: for each entry, record which bench the adjudicator overturned.

entries.size_amendment_20260822: upsized to 0.5% path (convergence + fired gate); grade adjusts for differential sizing

controls: cohort stop-rate and P&L vs SPY at 90/180d

red-vs-blue overturn asymmetry: 7 of 9 entries ride a red overturn — if the 90d grade shows the overturned-red cohort underperforming the convergence entries, the Fable audit layer has a lenience bias and §BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED needs teeth
aggregate exposure at staging: ~$27k ≈ 2.6% NAV; per-name floor sizes
